title: 2B Friend or Foe? — Идиомы: конкуренция и сотрудничество

items.example: Phone makers operate in a cut-throat industry where every secret matters.
Getting a new project off the ground is hugely expensive.
By sharing the load, both firms finished their research faster.
The desire to stay ahead of the pack pushes firms to do better.
For Norton, practising coopetition is a complete no-brainer.
Consumers reap the rewards of innovation when firms cooperate.
Partners must make sure everyone is on the same page about secrets.
In the future we could see bitter rivals working together on climate goals.
Toyota and General Motors joined forces to understand the US market.
Without cooperation the market becomes dog-eat-dog.
Firms share knowledge to stay ahead of the game.

items.idiom: give someone a run for their money
items.example: The small startup gave the market leader a run for its money.
When the merger talks failed, the gloves came off.
Coopetition is a win-win situation for firms and consumers.
